question: I'm a CS 5th-year student (P-010) in good standing. I need 5 courses in Spring 2026 to accumulate enough units to graduate. My planned courses: 15-441 (12), 15-316 (12), 70-381 (9), 70-311 (9), 21-355 (12) = 54 units. Is special approval required?

domain_contributions.policies: Overload policy: normal load ≈ 45 units. 54 units exceeds normal by 9 units. Up to 12 units above normal requires advisor approval; P-010 is in good standing so overload is not AW-blocked.
domain_contributions.courses: 5 courses totaling 54 units: 12+12+9+9+12 = 54 units; confirms the overload calculation

key_facts: 54 units = ~9 units above the ~45 normal load
P-010 is in good standing — not blocked by AW
Overload of up to 12 units above normal requires advisor approval
P-010 also already completed 70-311 (Fall 2024) — planning to retake would be redundant
Advisor approval is required; advisor must update S3 max units
wrong_if_single_domain: Knowing only the policy identifies the approval requirement but cannot calculate whether 54 units is actually an overload without knowing the normal load definition. Knowing only course unit counts cannot determine the approval pathway.
common_mistake: Assuming that 5 courses is automatically a prohibited overload without checking the actual unit totals against the policy threshold; also not catching that 70-311 was already completed
reasoning_chain: Step 2 (policies): Normal load ~45; 54 - 45 = 9 units overload → advisor approval required
Step 3: P-010 good standing → eligible for overload with approval
Step 4: Note 70-311 already done (Fall 2024) — P-010 should choose a different 9-unit course
Conclusion: 54-unit load is permitted with advisor approval; P-010 must replace 70-311 with an unfinished course
